description.narrative: The project is designed to encourage investments in Iraq and supports the development of a sound private sector in Iraq. It proposes to consolidate the achievements of the existing UNIDO project #Enterprise Development and Investment Promotion for the SME sector in Iraq# as well as expand upon them using the existing infrastructure and trained personnel of the four Iraqi Enterprise Development Centres (EDCs) as a strategic entry point. Constant synergies with UNIDO project #Enterprise Development through Information <(>&<)> Communication Technology (EDICT)# will be also reaped to integrate the training module in the on-line e-learning platform established by the EDICT Project. In the project steering committee meeting held in Rome in October 2012, it was decided that the Italian government should provide bridge funding for the year 2013-14 for continuation of EDC services in these governorates. This would allow the EDC host institutions to make arrangement to leverage funds from their respective governments for the year 2014 onwards. Soon after the October 2012 Steering Committee Meeting, the donor made available additional funding to continue supporting the four EDCs till June 2014.
